# Destructive signing-ceremony record template
#
# This is a blank schema for a later offline ceremony. Field names and
# placeholders only. Do not fill this file. Do not commit a filled record.
# A later checkpoint may write a filled record only to the gitignored path
# local/destructive-signing-ceremony-record.txt.
#
# FORBIDDEN in any filled record:
# - Private-key bytes
# - Keystore bytes
# - Store passwords
# - Key passwords
# - Secret environment-variable values
# - Device unlock credentials
